name: Eldur Corporation
old_description: Our Glass-to-Metal Seals provide electrical connections to components in hermetic packages even under extreme conditions.
about:
Eldur Corporation, operating as the Dietze Group, is headquartered in Bangor, Maine. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available sources.

The company manufactures hermetic interconnect components, including glass-to-metal seals, wire-based connector pins, high-precision stamped connector parts, and lead-in-wires for lighting and sensor applications. It offers custom interconnector solutions that span from concept development through series production, though facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not specified.

Eldur serves a range of industries: automotive, aerospace and military, electronics, lighting, energy, refrigeration, medical, and sensors. In automotive, its components meet the reliability demands of increasingly complex electronic systems; in aerospace and military, they withstand extreme temperatures and harsh environments; in medical, they enable hermetic sapphire windows and autoclavable connectors.

The company states its differentiation lies in providing custom interconnector solutions from concept to series production, with all products designed in close collaboration with customers and engineered to each application’s specific needs. Its mission is summarized as “We make connections!”
